title: Denoising 3D images: robustness of persistent homology measures
summary: When computing sub/super-level-set persistent homology (PH), the effect of noise may introduce millions of (short-lived) topological generators, presenting an obstacle to both the computation of PH of large 3D images, and any analysis of PH that incorporates the number of generators. As such, it is often necessary to denoise the data before computing its PH.
